summary: The last mechanism link is now receipt-backed. CheckRun d75f65e79d2d46c0ae313cb0c5532795 (completed, tests_passed, exit 0, 23 parsed observations, 0 parse errors) confirms index 17 under isolated execution: applying a JointImplicit change that removes a non-member leaves the node in a joint configuration with auto_leave=true and the voter set unchanged at [1,2,3] with outgoing_size equal to incoming_size, so an ordinary-looking removal of a node that is not present is enough to enter joint consensus. With index 16 repeating the guard admission under stale leader-local state and indices 19-21 repeating the decoded in-order rejections, the finding's mechanism now runs end to end on receipts: a joint change whose proposer did not remain leader long enough to leave the joint configuration left no leave entry, because the leave is proposed only by a node that is leader when it applies the change; the next leader's guard saw a non-joint tracker and a pendingConfIndex predating the committed change and admitted a second joint-enter change; and every node applying the log in order then hit a change its own Changer rejects with 'config is already joint', which applyConfChange turns into a process-fatal panic. Two consequences recorded: the availability defect stands on receipts for the guard admission, the no-op joint entry, the missing leave and the in-order rejection, and the class of triggering histories is wider than a deliberately no-op change because removing an absent node suffices. I promoted the no-op behaviour as knowledge and kept scope and counterweights explicit: the finding is about the unmitigated consequence under default validation rather than the existence of a documented best-effort check, the rejecting nodes are never the leader, the history is one seed and one log position, violations=0 keeps the claim about availability, storage faults and other sizes were not exercised, the election-to-stale-state path is still argued from source, and the receipts do not show which node proposed each entry or whether its proposer was displaced - that attribution runs through the auto-leave guard rather than through an observed dropped proposal.
